front.title: Gateway Capability Directory and Synchronization for Internet of Agents

abstract.t:
This document describes a gateway capability-directory framework for Internet of Agents deployments that maintain persistent capability views and exchange selected information across gateways. It defines requirements for Agent Capability Specifications (ACSs), derived Capability Digests, lifecycle state, provenance, validation, and synchronization. It clarifies authority-scoped revisions, remaining- lifetime preservation, withdrawal handling, partial views, and recovery after disconnection or state loss.
The framework distinguishes source descriptions from gateway-accepted objects and distinguishes directory visibility from semantic compatibility, authorization, and execution admission. It does not define a discovery query protocol, ranking algorithm, storage substrate, distributed lookup algorithm, synchronization wire format, task orchestration protocol, or agent session protocol. It provides requirements that can inform subsequent gateway procedures and protocol bindings.
